scenes.title_cn: 节奏感 = 一句话 + 一个动作
scenes.title_en: Rhythm = One Sentence Plus One Action
scenes.context: 主播的节奏感来源于：一句话配一个动作。一句话配一个动作。他做出来的感觉就是——我们来看一段s级主播。语域：直播教学，概念定义。
sentences: 主播的节奏感，来源于一句话配一个动作。
A streamer's rhythm comes from pairing one sentence with one action.
pairing one sentence with one action（一句话配一个动作）
他做出来的感觉，就是节奏感。
The feel he delivers is exactly that rhythm.
the feel he delivers（做出来的感觉）
我们来看一段S级主播。
Let's watch an S-tier streamer.
S-tier streamer（S级主播）
paraphrase: 一句话配一个动作 → one sentence plus one action / speech-action pairing
S级主播 → S-tier streamer / top-tier streamer
scenes.speak: A streamer's rhythm comes from pairing one sentence with one action. The feel he delivers is exactly that rhythm. Let's watch an S-tier streamer.

scenes.context: 每一个画面，就切一个动作。这件你看不上眼吧？切到档口展示。这样子的衬衫，你猜多少钱？切到面料。语域：直播教学，动作示范。
sentences: 这件你看不上眼吧？切到档口展示。
Not your cup of tea? Switch to the stall display.
Not your cup of tea（看不上眼）
这样子的衬衫，你猜多少钱？
A shirt like this — guess the price.
guess the price（猜多少钱）
每一句台词，就切一个动作。
Every line of dialogue gets its own action switch.
action switch（切动作）
paraphrase: 看不上眼 → not your cup of tea / not impressed
not your cup of tea · not impressed
切一个动作 → switch the action / change the motion
scenes.speak: Not your cup of tea? Switch to the stall display. A shirt like this — guess the price. Every line of dialogue gets its own action switch.

scenes.title_cn: 观众视角：画面切、声音叠
scenes.title_en: Audience View: Cut the Frame, Layer the Voice
scenes.context: 从观众的角度看：画面切换非常迅速，声音叠加上去。每个卖点都给到画面，节奏感就出来了。语域：直播教学，视角切换。
sentences: 从观众的角度看，画面切换非常迅速。
From the audience's view, the frames cut very fast.
frames cut very fast（画面切换迅速）
声音叠加，每个卖点都有画面。
Voices layer on, and every selling point gets a frame.
every selling point gets a frame（每个卖点都有画面）
节奏感，就这样出来了。
And that's how the rhythm comes out.
the rhythm comes out（节奏感出来了）
paraphrase: 画面切换 → frame cuts / visual transitions
声音叠加 → voice layering / sound on top
scenes.speak: From the audience's view, the frames cut very fast. Voices layer on, and every selling point gets a frame. And that's how the rhythm comes out.

scenes.title_en: Takeaway: Make the Viewer Feel Good
scenes.context: 你的直播要爽，观众才买单。你看他的直播爽不爽？很爽。所以节奏感=说话与画面的契合。语域：直播教学，总结。
sentences: 你的直播要爽，观众才买单。
Your stream must feel good for viewers to buy in.
buy in（买单）
你看他的直播爽不爽？很爽。
Is his stream fun to watch? Totally.
fun to watch（爽）
节奏感 = 说话与画面的契合。
Rhythm equals the fit between speech and visuals.
the fit between speech and visuals（说话与画面的契合）
paraphrase: 买单 → buy in / pay up
契合 → the fit / the match
scenes.speak: Your stream must feel good for viewers to buy in. Is his stream fun to watch? Totally. Rhythm equals the fit between speech and visuals.

practice: A streamer's rhythm comes from pairing one sentence with one action.
Every line of dialogue gets its own action switch.
Voices layer on, and every selling point gets a frame.
Rhythm equals the fit between speech and visuals.
pitfalls: Rhythm comes from pairing one sentence with one action.
「一句话配一个动作」用 pairing one sentence with one action。
「看不上眼」用 not your cup of tea。
「画面切换迅速」用 the frames cut fast。
Your stream must feel good for viewers to buy in.
「爽」用 feel good / fun to watch。
shifts: 用 pairing one sentence with one action（一句话配一个动作）、action switch（切动作）
用 frame cuts（画面切换）、visuals（画面）、transitions（转场）
用 buy in（买单）、fun to watch（看得爽）、feel good（爽）
